description: Every day 06:00 Madrid: audits translations added or changed in the last 24h across the 21 active Lokalise projects (glossary, style guide, register). Review sheet per language + #i18n-team post. Read-only.

parameters.content:
## Lokalise daily translation audit

Every day 06:00 Madrid. Scans the 21 active projects (lokalise_project_labels active, minus My QR Code html) for translations **added or changed in the last 24 h** (scanner 13B6pXdEIK8IXYv6, read-only), then audits only those keys with the nightly worker ME3cLqQy0Dlzm6si (glossary, style guide, register, accuracy, mechanics; same exclusions and reviewer precedent).

Strings already covered by a nightly run (weekdays 19:00) are skipped. Findings on strings last edited by a linguist are marked *Linguist edit = Yes* and are report-only.

Output: review sheet (tab per language, Decision dropdown) in the audit Drive folder + #i18n-team summary/thread; a one-line post when there are no findings. No Jira. The run is logged in targets_audit_rotation with an empty project_id so the review ingest (P7DawOGDYoHNobGx) picks up the ✅ — the nightly rotation ignores those rows.

activeVersion.name: Fix syntax error in Plan tab values
activeVersion.description: The two addConditionalFormatRule lines (red empty-reason highlight, amber linguist-edit highlight) were each missing one closing brace, so the Code node failed with "Unexpected token ')'" on every run that had findings (18, 20, 23 Oct).
